See The Difference

Before and After

Three examples of the jobs we take on, from how they started to how they were left.

Before After
Full Re-Roof

Tired Tiled Roof Replaced

Moss, slipped tiles and a sagging ridge had started to let the weather in. The old covering came off, the slope was felted and battened, and new dark grey tiles went on.

Drag the slider to compare the before and after.

Before After
Flat Roofing

Garage Felt Roof Renewed

The old felt had blistered and held water after every shower. It was stripped off and replaced with a smooth fibreglass roof, clean white trims and a new fascia.

Before After
Chimney Rebuild

Failed Stack Rebuilt

The pointing had gone, the pot was leaning and the flashing had been patched with tape. The stack was rebuilt in matching brick and finished with new lead.

How We Work

Why Choose WeatherSafe

We keep roofing simple. You get a straight answer, a clear price and a tidy job.

  • Free, Honest Quotes

    We look at the actual roof, explain what it needs and put it in writing.

  • We Turn Up

    You get a time, and a call if anything changes.

  • Repairs First

    If a repair will do the job, we will say so rather than sell you a new roof.

  • Photos Throughout

    You see what was wrong and what was done, even the parts you cannot get to.

  • Clean and Tidy

    Sheeted down, cleared up and the drive swept before we leave.

About Us

The Team Behind WeatherSafe

WeatherSafe Roofing and Repairs looks after homes and small businesses, from a single slipped tile to a complete re-roof. The idea is simple: treat every roof as if it were your own.

That means turning up when we say we will, explaining what we find in plain English, and showing you photos of the parts you cannot see. When the job is done, the site is cleared and the drive is swept.
